title: Low-degree coefficient hypothesis
statement: For nonnegative integers $n$ and $\ell$, a low-degree coefficient hypothesis is a package consisting of a coefficient array indexed by subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$, with values in $\mathbb F_2$.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definition of the coefficient arrays.
